_comment: GE FY2020 10-K (filed 2021-02-12) — second hand-validated gold filing. Cross-reference TOC filing format: the body is topically organized (not per-Item) and a 'FORM 10-K CROSS REFERENCE INDEX' at the document end maps each Item to a page range, 'Not applicable', or footnote letter pointing at the 2021 Proxy Statement. Phase 1 + regex_segment cross-ref TOC parser recovers 21/21 items with correct status hints. content_text for each item is the TOC entry text rather than body excerpt — the body content is intentionally not extracted because it spans multiple pages without per-Item anchors.

cover_page_incorporates._note: GE 2021 incorporates Items 11-14 by reference to the 2021 Proxy Statement; TOC footnotes (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) explicitly call this out. Cover-page detection currently doesn't fire for this filing — TOC footnote parsing is a Phase 2 enhancement.

expected_items.title_hint: Changes in and Disagreements with Accountants

expected_items._note: TOC footnote (a) -> 2021 Proxy Statement Compensation section

known_limitations: Item 1C (Cybersecurity) absent: only required for fiscal years ending after 2023-12-15 — GE FY2020 predates this rule
char_range_text values are inside the TOC region (~677000-679000), reflecting that we extract from TOC entries; body anchors are not recovered without LLM
content_text for each item is '[Cross-reference TOC] Title (page_ref)' — body extraction is deferred to Phase 2 (LLM)
